name: Ayanojou Reiko
source:
The object of admiration of the school. She is a beautiful, pure, and fair young lady.

She never tolerates evil, and no one can match her with a mouth. She is Miss Justice.

She is the head of the public morals committee, She is always checking up on the tardy students every morning.

She is usually firm, but when she is in a bad mood She can be rude (especially to the main character).

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
